title: Complete guest checkout by paying now
description: A guest can select a departure, enter booking details, pay by card now, and receive a booking confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr/tours/kapadokya-balon-rotasi/book
Select a departure date
Select the number of travellers
Fill in the full name field with Guest Booker
Fill in the e-mail field with guest@example.com
Fill in the phone field with a valid phone number
Fill in the billing address fields with valid address details
Select the pay now payment option
Fill in the card details with the prefilled test card information
Submit the booking form
Verify a booking confirmation is displayed
Verify a booking reference is displayed

title: Open the site in Turkish
description: A visitor can open the site from the root path and land on the Turkish home page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the Turkish home page is displayed

title: Recover a booking with matching reference and email
description: This verifies that a returning guest can find the correct reservation by entering both the booking reference and the booking email and see the matching summary.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr/reservations
Fill in the booking reference field with a valid booking reference
Fill in the booking email field with the email used for that booking
Search for the reservation
Verify the matching reservation summary is displayed

title: Start checkout with a selected departure date
description: A visitor can choose a departure from a tour page and reach checkout with that departure preselected.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr/tours
Click a tour card
Click a departure selection control
Verify the checkout page is displayed
Verify the chosen departure is preselected in checkout

title: Recover an existing reservation
description: A returning guest can look up a reservation with a reference code and booking e-mail and see the reservation details.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr/reservations
Fill in the reservation reference field with a valid reference
Fill in the booking e-mail field with the matching e-mail
Submit the reservation lookup form
Verify the reservation details are displayed
Verify the booking summary is displayed

title: Browse featured tours and open the full catalogue
description: A visitor can view featured tours on the home page and reach the full tour catalogue to compare tour cards.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr
Click the link to view all tours
Verify the full tour catalogue is displayed
Verify multiple tour cards are displayed for comparison

title: Complete guest checkout by holding the seat
description: A guest can select a departure, enter booking details, hold the seat, and receive a pending confirmation summary.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr/tours/kapadokya-balon-rotasi/book
Select a departure date
Select the number of travellers
Fill in the full name field with Guest Booker
Fill in the e-mail field with guest@example.com
Fill in the phone field with a valid phone number
Fill in the billing address fields with valid address details
Select the hold the seat payment option
Submit the booking form
Verify a pending booking confirmation is displayed
Verify a booking reference is displayed

title: Open a tour detail page from browsing
description: A visitor can open a tour card and reach the corresponding tour detail page.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr
Click a tour card
Verify the tour detail page is displayed
Verify the tour itinerary and pricing information are displayed

title: Switch the site from Turkish to English on the same page
description: This verifies that a visitor can change the language to English while staying on the same page and keeping context.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr
Click the English language switcher
Verify the page is displayed in English
Verify the current page content remains on the home page

title: Review itinerary gallery and live departures on a tour page
description: A visitor can inspect a tour detail page and see the itinerary, gallery, and live departure availability.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr/tours
Click a tour card
Verify the day-by-day itinerary is displayed
Verify the gallery and departure availability are displayed

title: Show a not found result for an incorrect reservation lookup
description: This verifies that an incorrect booking reference or email produces a not found result and allows the guest to try again.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr/reservations
Fill in the booking reference field with an invalid booking reference
Fill in the booking email field with an email that does not match the reservation
Search for the reservation
Verify a not found message is displayed
Start a new search
Verify the lookup form is ready for another search

title: Switch language in the header while staying on the same page
description: A bilingual visitor can switch between Turkish and English from the header without losing the current page context.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr/tours
Click the English language switcher
Verify the page content is displayed in English
Verify the tour catalogue remains open

title: Start booking without preselecting a departure
description: A visitor can begin checkout from a tour page without choosing a departure first and still reach the booking form.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr/tours
Click a tour card
Click the booking button
Verify the checkout page is displayed
Verify the booking form is ready for trip details

title: Retry reservation lookup after no match
description: A returning guest can submit an incorrect reservation lookup and then correct it to find the booking.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr/reservations
Fill in the reservation reference field with an invalid reference
Fill in the booking e-mail field with the matching e-mail
Submit the reservation lookup form
Verify a reservation not found message is displayed
Replace the reservation reference with a valid reference
Submit the reservation lookup form
Verify the reservation details are displayed

title: Jump from the home page to a section using the header navigation
description: This verifies that the fixed header can move a visitor from the home page to a key section without losing the current page context.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr
Click the header navigation link to a main section
Verify the selected section is displayed in the page content
Verify the visitor remains on the home page

title: Use the mobile header menu to navigate without losing locale
description: A mobile user can open the header menu and navigate to another page while staying in the same locale.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr
Open the header menu
Click the link to view all tours
Verify the tour catalogue is displayed
Verify the Turkish locale is preserved

title: Open the mobile menu and review the navigation options
description: This verifies that a mobile user can open the full-screen menu and see the available navigation options.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr
Open the mobile menu
Verify the mobile navigation options are displayed
Verify the page content is still accessible behind the menu

title: Mark a tour as favourite while browsing
description: A visitor can favourite a tour card and keep that favourite state visible while continuing to browse the tour list.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr/tours
Click the favourite control on a tour card
Verify the tour card shows a favourited state
Verify the favourite state remains visible while browsing the catalogue

title: Use the home page lookup panel to search reservations inline
description: A visitor can use the home page booking lookup panel to search for an existing reservation without leaving the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr
Fill in the reservation reference field in the home page lookup panel with a valid reference
Fill in the booking e-mail field in the home page lookup panel with the matching e-mail
Submit the home page lookup form
Verify the reservation summary is displayed on the home page
Verify the lookup result remains within the landing page context

title: Open the contact link from a tour page
description: A visitor can use the tour page contact action to open the question link for the tour.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr/tours
Click a tour card
Click the question link
Verify the contact link is opened
Verify a mail-based contact action is available

title: Close the mobile menu with Escape
description: This verifies that a mobile user can dismiss the open menu with the Escape key and return to browsing.

steps.description: Navigate to /tr
Open the mobile menu
Press Escape
Verify the mobile menu is closed
Verify the home page content is visible
